name: performance-profiler
description: Turns Antigravity into a performance engineering expert. Diagnoses and fixes Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), backend latency bottlenecks, database query inefficiencies, Node.js memory leaks, and mobile app jank. Adds a pre-deploy bundle size gate to catch regressions before production.
suggestedPrompts: Analyze my frontend bundle, identify what's killing my LCP score and how to fix it
Profile my Node.js backend and find the memory leak causing OOM crashes in production
Audit my SQL queries and API response times, then give me a prioritized optimization plan
